layout/empty:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="{{ locale_name }}">
<head>
    <title>{{ head.title }}</title>
    {{{ head.meta_tags }}}
     <meta charset="UTF-8">
    {{{ head.config }}}

    <link href="{{ head.favicon }}" rel="shortcut icon">
    {{#block "head"}}{{/block}}
</head>
<body class="{{page_type}}--cavio {{#if theme_settings.themeVariant 'Natural'}}natural-variant{{else if theme_settings.themeVariant 'Parts'}}parts-variant{{else if theme_settings.themeVariant 'Active'}}active-variant{{/if}}
">
    {{#block "page"}}{{/block}}
</body>
</html>
